letGo.ask: Let {{name}} go? Their chat, routines and watches go too. (Their files and notes stay on disk.)
letGo.keepOne: Keep at least one agent around 🙂

job.label: Takes care of
job.placeholder: What's the one thing they look after?

boundary.label: Comes back to you when
boundary.placeholder: Anything that costs money, speaks for you in a new way, or can't be undone.

watching.title: Watching

routines.title: Routines
routines.empty: None yet. Try “every Monday at 9…” in chat.

checkins.title: 💓 Check in on its own
checkins.body: About once an hour (8:00–23:00) {{name}} looks over its job and only messages you if something really matters.
